extraction.Name: James Wright
extraction.Recorded patent: patent was recorded April 9, 1920 by E. V. Youngquist
extraction.Buyer: Conveyed the Northwest quarter of section 11, township 99, north of range 78 to E. V. Youngquist for $1.00 and other valuable consideration; on August 10, 1922, James and Jennie Wright conveyed the North half of section 13, township 97, N. R. 79 to William M. Kunde for $7000
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739706 issued; Northeast quarter of section 13, township 97, range 79; deed dated April 13, 1920 signed by Mr. Wright and wife; sale to Kunde for $7000 would include the Northeast quarter of section 13; receipt for patent signed by allottee April 2, 1920; wife named Jennie Wright
